regions.text: Weymouth made it ten league games unbeaten with a 3–0 win at Barnstaple. Toby Holmes and Sam Jackson struck early before Tor Swann added the third. The Terras remained second, two points behind Dorchester.

Falmouth earned a 1–1 draw at Swindon Supermarine. Luke Barner put Town ahead before Partridge equalised after the break. Marine surrendered top spot and finished Saturday third, level on points with second-placed Weymouth.
WESTBURY WIN IT AT THE DEATH

Westbury reached the play-off places with a dramatic 1–0 win over Hungerford. Eben Mortimer-Taylor struck deep into stoppage time. The visitors finished with eight players, while two further red cards went to their bench.

Bideford twice came from behind to win 3–2 at Bishop’s Cleeve. Finn King-Smith cancelled out an own goal before Ross Langworthy restored the lead. Jordan Ewing’s penalty and Farren Simons’ late winner turned the contest.

Dorchester reclaimed top spot with a 3–1 win at Sporting Club Inkberrow. The Magpies recovered from falling behind to record their tenth successive league victory. Player-coach Will Spetch praised their determination and togetherness.
Bailey Kempster’s stoppage-time strike earned Willand a 3–3 draw at Slimbridge. His second goal of the afternoon cancelled out Olly Sully’s late effort. Joel Jackson was also on target for Rovers.
